display.summary: A dynamic modal now announces the content it injects, so builders that arrive inside one initialise on every load instead of only when they win a race with the dialog opening.
highlights: The Ribbon builder no longer opens empty, or fills and then blanks a second later, on a slow link or a large settings modal.
Its “Show system items” toggle works again — that listener is bound during initialisation, which is what was being skipped.
Ribbon catalog discovery logs what it swallows instead of degrading to an empty builder in silence.
